tools.name: list_pathway_types
tools.title: Daftar jenis clinical pathway
tools.description: List the clinical pathway types (jenis CP) configured in the app along with their LOS target in days.

tools.name: list_patients
tools.title: Daftar pasien clinical pathway
tools.description: List clinical pathway patient records, optionally filtered by year, month, pathway type, ward, or patient name / medical record number.

pathway_type.description: Exact jenis clinical pathway, e.g. 'Intracranial Hemorrhagia'.

search.description: Partial match on patient name or medical record number (no_rm).

limit.description: Max rows to return, default 50, capped at 200.

tools.name: get_patient
tools.title: Detail pasien & kepatuhan
tools.description: Get one clinical pathway patient record together with its compliance data (kepatuhan CP, penunjang, terapi, sesuai target) and checklist items.

no_rm.description: Medical record number; used when patient_id is not given.

tools.name: compliance_summary
tools.title: Rekap kepatuhan clinical pathway
tools.description: Summarise clinical pathway compliance for a given year (optionally one pathway type): patient counts and percentage of kepatuhan CP, penunjang, terapi, and LOS sesuai target, broken down per month.

pathway_type.description: Limit to one jenis clinical pathway.
